name: Shirane (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Shirane town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines with four small points, enclosing the character 白.
history: Flag of the former town of Shirane in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2003-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 2 October 1954.

features.role: Shirane town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines with four small points, enclosing the character 白
